name: RoChess!
desc:
♟️ RoChess! ♟️
Play fast, rated chess on Roblox against real people!

♟️ Rated online games across 9 time controls
🔍 Game Review with accuracy scores, see your brilliant moves and blunders!
🧩 1,300+ rated puzzles
📊 Analysis Board with a live engine
🤖 19 bots from Beginner to Master, powered by Vortex chess engine
📖 3,800+ openings recognised as you play
🏆 Leaderboards for Bullet, Blitz, Rapid and Puzzles

💡 New to chess? Start with an easy bot and work your way up to master!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite to get updates!
